narrative: Dr Anita Lamprecht contributed to Agroverse, Cypher Defense, and TrueSight DAO over two years, from October 2022 to October 2024. She focused primarily on the Build Game - Strategy rubric, attending Facetime meetings every 30 minutes (8 contributions), providing hyperlink reference materials (7), participating in online polls (5), suggesting ideas (3), contributing reference materials with strategy extension ideas (3), reviewing strategies with specific improvements (3), reiterating pending decision signals (3), and reviewing strategies with cautions (3). Her work supported strategic development across these projects.
